implication: A readable CAS-realization prefix changes Pythia's conditional likelihood in the intended direction. That supports a harness bridge: read CAS structure, realize it as language, and condition generation. This is external prompt conditioning, not internal-neuron steering. Raw CAS-symbol prefixes do not appear meaningful to Pythia by themselves.
plain_english_read: This tests the eta-to-epsilon bridge as conditional likelihood instead of numbered-choice behavior. It asks whether CAS symbols or readable CAS realizations make the true Drive phrase more likely than the partner Drive phrase.
